items.heading: Ghormeh Sabzi
details: Key ingredients: lamb, herbs, dried lime, kidney beans
Fry a large mix of chopped fresh herbs until dark and fragrant.
Brown lamb pieces and combine with the fried herbs.
Add dried lime and kidney beans, then simmer for a long time.
Cook until the lamb is tender and the sauce is deep green, then serve with rice.

items.heading: Tahdig
details: Key ingredients: rice, saffron, yogurt, butter
Parboil rice until just short of tender.
Mix a portion of the rice with yogurt and saffron for the crust layer.
Layer the plain and yogurt rice in a pot with plenty of butter on the bottom.
Steam gently until a golden, crisp crust forms on the bottom, then flip to serve.

items.heading: Chelo Kebab
details: Ingredients: meat or vegetables, yogurt/oil, garlic, spices, salt and lemon.
Marinate the main ingredient, thread or shape, then grill or broil until cooked and lightly charred.
